title: Authentication requests fail with HTTP 401/403 after deployment
description: From 16 August 2026 17:02 UTC to 17:31 UTC, users began receiving HTTP 401 and HTTP 403 responses when attempting to sign in to SecureDesk. The failures began shortly after a new auth-service deployment. Previously valid accounts were affected. Database health, network connectivity, and application CPU remained within normal operating ranges.

evidence.content: SecureDesk uses JWT tokens. Flow: Client -> auth-service -> JWT validation -> issuer/audience verification -> user authorization -> authenticated session. The JWT issuer must match the configured trusted issuer. If the issuer configuration is incorrect, otherwise valid tokens can fail validation.

For widespread authentication failures: 1. Check token validation errors 2. Check issuer configuration 3. Check audience configuration 4. Compare current configuration against the previous deployment 5. Verify whether failures started immediately after deployment 6. Check database and network health to eliminate unrelated causes.
Normal Authentication Baseline: HTTP 401/403 rate <1%, JWT validation success >99%, Database latency <100ms, Network packet loss <0.1%, CPU utilization <70%.

Previous deployment: JWT_ISSUER=https://auth.securedesk.com. Current deployment: JWT_ISSUER=https://authentication.securedesk.com. The configured issuer does not match the issuer contained in existing tokens.
Before deployment: JWT validation success 99.6%, HTTP 401/403 rate 0.4%. After deployment: JWT validation success 21.3%, HTTP 401/403 rate 78.7%.
